description: “The 2026 legislative session has come to a merciful end – with a sprint to the finish before collapsing under its own failures. In the waning days, Albany Democrats worked to pass laws in the middle of the night that give more help to their own political interest than any practical solutions for New Yorkers. title: STATEMENT FROM ASSEMBLY MINORITY LEADER ED RA ON THE END OF THE 2026 LEGISLATIVE SESSION
